sourcePatterns.reason: a visibility gate on the animated keyboard inset stays true until the keyboard's last frame, so the control's own entrance starts after the keyboard has gone (user 2026-11-10); take the keyboard's animation target or progress from the shared helper (ImeSignal.kt)

K24 / CR-92 (Fold 2026-11-10 14:05): a WebView evaluateJavascript callback pending across a navigation may never come; the suspending wait needs its own withTimeout / withTimeoutOrNull on the same line or within 3 lines above, and ends as a named failure. Fire-and-forget calls (callback null) are not waits.
